items.description:
Located in the heart of Montpellier’s historic centre, 500 metres from Place de la Comédie and next to Polygone Shopping Centre, Pullman La Pléiade Montpellier Centre features an all-year-round outdoor pool on the rooftop terrace, which is heated from April to October. Free WiFi access is available throughout. The hotel is less than 20 km from both Palavas-les-Flots and La Grande Motte beaches.

All of the spacious guest rooms feature a unique, contemporary décor and air conditioning. Each has a large flat-screen TV, a courtesy tray, 2 free bottles of water and a private bathroom with a bath or shower.

Pullman Montpellier Centre has a panoramic restaurant and 1 bar. Le Vertigo rooftop restaurant serves regional cuisine. Guests can dine in the dining room or enjoy the panoramic views from the outdoor terrace.

Other facilities in the hotel include a fitness centre and free valet parking service. The multilingual staff at the Pullman Montpellier Centre are available 24 hours. The property is 8 km from both the Arena Concert Hall and Montpellier Exhibition Centre. Montpellier Saint-Roch Train Station is 750 M from the hotel while Montpellier Méditerranée Airport is 10 km away. Public parking is available at Polygone Shopping Centre, for an additional fee.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.1 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
We offer private accommodation and a lift, free Wi-Fi and private parking. Reception is open 24/7. Every one of our 147 apartments is furnished, with a kitchen area equipped with a hob, fridge, kettle, microwave and dishwasher. From the double studio to the 3-room family apartment that can accommodate up to 6 guests, this residence is perfect for all your business trips or holidays. For your comfort, our team recommends you choose some of our à la carte services, such as housekeeping and laundry. This leaves you more time to relax on our terrace. Welcome to Appart’City, France's leading aparthotel brand with over 90 destinations across France and Europe. We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Just 4 minutes away from your apartment, tram lines 2 and 4 mean that you can travel around Montpellier easily and quickly. Thanks to our location just a few minutes on foot from Place de la Comédie, you can have a drink on a terrace in front of the Opéra Comédie, or even wander around the narrow, shaded streets of the Ecusson, the historic centre characterised by its authentic architecture and plentiful museums and cultural spaces. Whether travelling by bike, by tram or by car, succumb to an afternoon at the seaside, with the Palavas-les-Flots beach just 11km away.

hostInfo.welcomeMessage: It offers comfortable private accommodation with a private car park and free Wi-Fi. Reception is open 24/7. Every one of our 113 apartments is furnished, with a kitchen area equipped with a hob, fridge, cafetière, microwave and dishwasher. From a double studio to the apartment that can accommodate up to 4 guests, this residence is perfect for all your business trips or holidays. The study area is ideal for Montpellier students, who will be staying 10 minutes away from the local universities. If you are visiting on a business trip, there is a business corner available for various kinds of event (seminar, meeting) with several meeting rooms and all the necessary equipment. Those looking for some relaxation will appreciate our popular well-being space, which includes a gym and sauna. For extra comfort, our team recommends you choose our à la carte services, such as housekeeping and a breakfast buffet.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: They say you can't have it all. Comfort or adventure ? Work or relaxation ? Freedom or hotel services ? What if we replaced “or” with “and” ? Welcome to Appart’City, France's leading aparthotel brand with over 90 destinations across France and Europe. We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: From your apartment, the number 9 bus will take you to the tram stop, so that you can get around the heart of Montpellier quickly and easily. In less than 15 minutes, you will be in the historic centre, where you can wander in the shade through the narrow streets of the Ecusson area, admiring the city's authentic architecture and trying out specialities from the region. Our aparthotel is located 15 minutes from Montpellier Méditerranée airport and the Arena. The quick access to the Grande Motte, Palavas-les-Flots and Carnon beaches make our aparthotel the ideal base for your escape to the south.

Lovers of history and architecture can admire the area's unusual buildings and hotels and visit the school of medicine, the oldest university in the western world still to be running. Visitors can live like the locals on the sun-drenched terraces of the Place de la Comédie, in the plentiful lively bars and restaurants in the area, or taking in the breathtaking views over the Pic Saint Loup and the Mediterranean sea from the Porte du Jardin du Peyrou, the gate to the city.

Goélia Sun City – Montpellier

Welcome to Goélia Sun City, located at 70/72 avenue du Pont de Juvénal, 34000 Montpellier.

Our residence enjoys an ideal location in the heart of Montpellier, close to the famous Antigone district, the Le Polygone shopping centre, and approximately a 15-minute walk from Place de la Comédie. Bus and tram stops are also within easy walking distance, making it convenient to explore the city.

Apartments

Our fully equipped apartments include:

Private bathroom
Equipped kitchenette
Free Wi-Fi
Flat-screen TV
Balcony
Elevator access
Breakfast

Available by reservation at Reception.

Breakfast is served:

Monday to Friday: 7:30 a.m. – 10:00 a.m.
Saturday and Sunday: 8:00 a.m. – 10:30 a.m.

Breakfast is served on the ground floor. Please come to Reception and provide your room number to access the breakfast area.

Reception

Reception is open 7 days a week:

Monday to Saturday: 7:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
Sunday: 8:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.

If you arrive outside reception opening hours, please contact the residence in advance to receive the necessary arrival instructions.

Swimming Pool

The outdoor swimming pool is open:

Daily from 10:00 a.m. to 8:45 p.m.

The pool is seasonal and is closed every year from the end of September until the end of April.

Solarium and Fitness Room

Guests can enjoy:

A solarium area
A fitness room
Laundry Facilities

A laundry room is available within the residence. Information regarding use and prices is available at Reception.

Departure and Cleaning

Check-out must be completed before 10:00 a.m.

Your apartment is fully cleaned and prepared before your arrival.

Before departure, guests are kindly requested to leave the apartment clean:

Wash and put away dishes
Empty the dishwasher
Take out the rubbish
Leave the kitchenette clean and tidy

End-of-stay cleaning covers the general maintenance of the accommodation. However, kitchen cleaning and tidying remain the responsibility of guests.

No housekeeping service is provided during your stay.

Bed linen and towels are provided upon arrival. No linen or towel changes are included during the stay. Any additional replacement remains at the guest’s expense.

Group Bookings
